framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Governs disclosure, open offer and creeping acquisition thresholds if Sportking or acquirer crosses 25% / 75% ownership.
If merger/scheme, requires NCLT approval and creditor voting.
CCI approval required if combined turnover or assets exceed thresholds (₹1,500 cr / ₹500 cr as of 2023).
If target is distressed or undergoing insolvency, acquisition mechanics differ.
If acquirer or target has foreign investment, FDI policy and RBI approval may apply.
